<!-- pr-reviewer: 348b448076ab563d52cce962f465b6b200a9785b -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- The change is small. `selection_refusal` (`crates/app/src/operation/picks.rs:113`) now lets a refusal pass only when its text starts with the shared constant `STITCHED_RIM` and holds `LINE_FROM_ABOVE`. Both stitch sites use the constant, so the text cannot drift.
- Generate still refuses by name. `selection_geometry_impl` is not changed. `selection_region` (`selection.rs`) returns the error with `?`, and `job.rs` passes it on. There is no fallback to a whole-model pocket. The new test checks the sentence from `GenerateOperation::new` and from `selection_account`.
- No other path can make a toolpath from a selection that was refused before. All door callers (`SetOperationGeometry`, `CreateOperation`, `EditOperationLinks`, kind change) go through `area_gate` in `gates.rs`. All of them only store the picks. Every route to a toolpath goes through the same walk, and that walk still returns the error. Contour, Plasma and Wire kinds never used this door.
- A wall face pick and a closed chain on a wall still meet the door (the existing tests pass).
- No change to the toolpath code, the posts or the project format. No snapshot PNG, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no process file. The decision record is present. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1726`.

## Results (merged with main, run locally; no runner used)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test pick_doors`: 8 passed.
- `--test area_picks --test area_open --test box_pick`: 11, 5 and 7 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- first_ctrl_click edge_click_modifiers geo_ pick` (CWD `crates/ui`): 116 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Mutation check of `edge_picks_that_meet_only_from_above_pass_the_pick_door`:
- Remove the new filter: the test fails. The door refuses with "the stitched rim of 'part' projects to a line from above and bounds no area".
- Make the filter pass every refusal (`.filter(|_| false)`): the new test fails. Five existing wall and face tests fail too.
- So the test pins both sides: the new accept case and the old refuse case.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- The test does not pin the `LINE_FROM_ABOVE` half of the filter. A looser filter (prefix only) would still pass. The risk is small, because a stitched ring refuses only for that reason in this walk.
- A selection that mixes a stitched collapse with a wall face is stored if the walk meets the stitched ring first. Generate refuses it in the same way, so this is safe. The page shows the sentence.
- The PR body says a UI change needs before and after screenshots. The author says an agent cannot make them. The maintainer decides if the PR waits for them.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
